messages:
deploy-bot: Finished deploy v2.18.0 -> prod-dedicated-us-west. Canary: host-a passed, host-b failed healthcheck 3/5. Synthetic probes flagged increased 5xx rate. Link: https://redwood/ops/deploy/1769001110 :rocket:

ravi: saw same, /v1/generate 500s around 12:05-12:12. dashboard spike.

sarah: can someone paste failing log from host-b? suspect kernel mismatch after quant change.

maria: running manual smoke now...

maria: ```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.prod.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' -d '{"input":"test"}'
# response: 500 internal server error, stack: InferenceRuntime::Execute -> KernelSelect
```

qa-jen: synthetic probe config: every 30s, timeout 3s. host-b failures 18/60 in last 30min (30%).

oncall-luis: recommend pause canary rollouts and route traffic off host-b. If fails after routing, rollback to v2.17.5.

alex: can we pin model to model-foo-v1.4-qt? That one has known working kernels.

sarah: agreed. I'll update routing policy and pin in service config. Doing a temporary release pin and disabling batched quant path.

deploy-bot: Action: pause canary, remove host-b from LB, pin model=foo@v1.4-qt, create incident ticket #INC-4021. (actions queued)

maria: running warm-up after pin, reporting back in 5m.

maria: warm-up done, smoke curl ok, 200, <200ms

qa-jen: synthetic probe recovery: failures drop to 0/20 after 8min. Monitoring for 15m.

oncall-luis: no rollback needed. We'll keep pin until tomorrow change window 02:00 UTC to re-evaluate with safer kernel rollout.

sarah: I'll add release note: "v2.18.0: canary paused due to healthcheck flapping on host-b; pinned model to foo@v1.4-qt pending kernel fix; follow-up during change window".

alex: add to release notes and changelog PR#789

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-4021. Follow-ups: postmortem if regression persists. :white_check_mark:

ravi: thanks all. :thumbsup:
